title: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai
desc: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai tells the heroic story of Rani Lakshmibai, a fearless queen who led a valiant resistance against British rule. Defying all odds, she became a symbol of courage, sacrifice, and India's fight for freedom.

title: Golmaal Kids
desc: Golmaal Kids is a light-hearted comedy about a group of mischievous orphans whose playful antics lead them into an unexpected adventure.

title: Tirangaa
desc: An elite spy with the Research and Analysis Wing grapples with her heart in a race against time as she embarks on a dangerous mission to take out a deadly terrorist in the Middle East.

title: Mangal Pandey (the Rising)
desc: It is the year 1857. The British are plundering the resources of their Indian subjects, who have reached their breaking point. Soldier Mangal Pandey (Aamir Khan) leads an uprising against India's imperialist occupiers -- events the British call a mutiny and the Indians call a war for independence. Throughout the violent events, Mangal maintains a friendship with Capt. William Gordon (Toby Stephens), who sympathizes with India's subjugated citizens and obeys his conscience.

title: Maine Pyar Kyon Kiya
desc: A romantic comedy about a man named Samir who lies about being married to avoid the advances of his co-worker, Sonia. When Sonia finds out the truth, she starts dating Samir's friend Vicky. As Samir tries to win back Sonia's love, he faces humorous misunderstandings and complicated love triangles.

title: Dear Maya
desc: Anna and Ira prank a local woman by writing her letters from a secret admirer. However, the prank takes a more serious turn when the local woman goes missing.
